retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast composition featuring a throne constructed from fused swords against a black background with silver metallic serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A towering, jagged throne made of hundreds of overlapping, rusted, and fused medieval swords, illuminated by a cold, desaturated blue light that creates deep shadows and sharp highlights on the metallic edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry of the throne structure
High contrast between the dark background and metallic highlights
Text overlaying the central mass of the subject
Cold color temperature emphasizing a somber tone
coreInvariants: Jagged, radiating silhouette of sword blades

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The throne is centrally positioned, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame, creating a sense of overwhelming scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cluster of sword hilts at the center-top of the seat back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the sharp radiating blades at the top down to the large metallic title in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black void surrounding the throne, focusing all attention on the intricate metal texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated steel blue for mid-tones and highlights on metal.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright silver/white for the sharpest blade edges and typographic highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation; high value contrast between shadows and specular highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Modified 'O' characters featuring internal vertical bars
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' contains three vertical lines resembling a cage or crest
The 'T' in the primary title has an elongated top bar that underlines the preceding word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classical high-contrast serif for branding paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines integrated into letterforms

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical Roman authority and sharp serifs
Provides the cinematic fantasy feel with similar proportions

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail 3D render of a throne made of hundreds of fused, jagged medieval swords. Use a dark, desaturated blue lighting scheme with a pure black background. Focus on the texture of cold steel and sharp edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply metallic, beveled silver typography in the lower third. Use a Trajan-style font for the main title with custom vertical bars inside the 'O' characters. Add a small, wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle above it.

verificationChecks: Is the 'O' modified with vertical bars?
Is the throne centered and symmetrical?
Does the text have a 3D chiseled effect?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color bleeding from the background into the silver text
Verify the sword hilts are distinct and not a blurred mass
Check that the horizontal line from the 'T' is perfectly straight
Confirm the background is absolute black (#000000)
recipe.reuseFormula: Central jagged metallic subject + monochromatic cold lighting + beveled Roman serif typography + wide-tracked sans-serif metadata.
